summary: Blackstone Multi-Strategy Hedge Fund L.P. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Dealer Manager Agreement with affiliate Blackstone Securities Partners L.P. Under the agreement, the Dealer Manager will engage third-party brokers to distribute the Fund's partnership units and the Offshore Fund's participating shares. The Dealer Manager receives a servicing fee of up to 0.85% of NAV per annum, which may be reallowed to participating brokers. This is a routine distribution and fee arrangement, not a special situation. No event like acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring is involved.
